brainstormed_titles.title: Deploying ArcKit in the Enterprise: Mastering Architecture Governance Across All LLM Platforms
brainstormed_titles.rationale: This title clearly communicates the enterprise focus while emphasizing the multi-platform coverage. It positions the book as authoritative and comprehensive, appealing to enterprise architects and CTOs who need to standardize AI governance across diverse LLM deployments.

brainstormed_titles.title: ArcKit Enterprise: A Unified Architecture Governance Framework for Claude, Codex, Copilot, and Beyond
brainstormed_titles.rationale: This title leads with the ArcKit brand while emphasizing the enterprise application. The subtitle positions the book as providing a cohesive approach, and explicitly naming key platforms signals comprehensive coverage.
